I'm using an application to estimate the different habitats in a specific area. I'm having a hard time selecting between transects or points sampling check.

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: transects or spots
parts:
Natacha

If your the habitat in your study area is highly fragmented, it may be easier to use points to lay into your different habitat types.  Understand however, that performing estimation is more difficult when using point transects because there are few animals in the area near to your point available to be detected (the place where your analysis would benefit from a large numbers of detections).

I forgot to say that my goal is to find if the application gives me accurate type of habitats. So the sampling will be on the field.
